trigger: HAWKING_GRAVITY_SERVE_FIRST_GENERATION.json reported two prompt-independent eight-token completions and left artifact collapse versus an unconditioned serve path unresolved.
source_trace: chat_completions renders the user messages into GenerateRequest.prompt with the artifact GLM template
BatchDriver::admit tokenizes req.prompt and Scheduler::admit stores the original GenerateRequest plus its prompt ids
when prefill_slot is unimplemented, the fallback clones that stored request and calls Engine::generate(req)
GravityEngine::generate tokenizes req.prompt, calls model.forward on the complete prompt ids, then continues with forward_at

trials.user_text: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

tokenizer_probe.verdict: The two rendered prompts produce distinct lengths and distinct content-token sequences before model execution.

conclusion.excluded: The serving fallback does not replace the prompt with an empty or constant context.
not_excluded: a runtime arithmetic, weight-resolution, or model-layout defect after prompt tokenization
a template semantic mismatch despite byte-preserving user content
conclusion.required_discriminator: Compare complete real-artifact first-token logits and exact top-k/argmax against an independent FP64/container oracle for both distinct prompt token sequences; then validate incremental replay. Do not infer artifact collapse from repeated output alone.
